pages.title: How Things Connect
pages.text:
Most mods explain themselves. What they don't explain is how they plug into each other. This section is about those joins.

Almost every connection in this pack runs through a few shared things.

- **Rotation** and **electricity**, and the blocks that convert between them
- **Heat**, mostly from the Blaze Burner
- **Liquid fuel**, mostly from oil
- **Metals** several mods share
- **Destinations** for every vehicle

Each entry here is short and points to the full entries. Read it when you wonder "can this mod's thing go into that mod's machine?"

Also worth knowing: anything that burns makes smog, and anything hot warms you up. See [#](2E5AAC)[Side Effects](entry://connections/side_effects)[#]().
